name: EXM_PREFERENCES
description: This table contains the session preferences of expense entry users.

columns.name: PREFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a person's preferences.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Stores the mobile phone number provided by the user for sending SMS text notifications.

columns.name: SMS_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether SMS text notifications are enabled for the user.

columns.name: COMMUTE_TO_ADDRESS
columns.description: Stores the last used work address provided by the user for calculating commute distance.

columns.name: COMMUTE_FROM_ADDRESS
columns.description: Stores the last used home address provided by the user for calculating commute distance.

columns.name: APPROVER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a person has received requests to approve expense reports, cash advance requests, or both.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person whose preferences are stored.

columns.name: APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the last used expense template.

columns.name: PURPOSE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the last used expense location.

columns.name: VEHICLE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Default vehicle category for a mileage expense.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description: Default vehicle type for a mileage expense.

columns.name: FUEL_TYPE
columns.description: Default fuel type for a mileage expense.

columns.name: TIME_FORMAT
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: DEFAULT_EXCHANGE_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: ENABLE_ALLOCATIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: REPORT_CREATION_CODE
columns.description: When expense reports are automatically created from trips by the application.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EXPENSE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the last expense item created.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Receipt currency of the last expense item created.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: EXPENSE_LOCATION
columns.description: Expense location that was used in the last expense report.

columns.name: VALIDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether an expense item is validated on saving the item.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Reimbursement currency used for the last expense report created.

columns.name: LAST_EXP_WORKAREA_VISIT_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of the user's last visit to the Expenses work area.

columns.name: AUTO_SUBMIT_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates if the AUTO SUBMIT job should pick up the user's expenses for report creation. The value can be set at user level.
The column will have a null value by default and null is treated as Y. If the value is null or Y, autosubmit will pickup expenses for the user, else it would not.

columns.name: COMMUTE_DISTANCE
columns.description: Last calculated commute distance based on addresses entered by employee.

columns.name: TERMS_AGREEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the user agreed to the terms and conditions for using Expenses.

columns.name: ONBOARDING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the onboarding status of the user.

columns.name: AUTO_SUBMIT_RUN_DAY_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the day of the week when the auto submit process runs for the user.
